main_text.p: Sectas البناجية منهن واحدة والباقون هلكي quarum una tantum saluti, reliquae perditioni destinatae sunt. Interrogatum deinde, & quae esset illa una? respondisse اهل السنة والجماعة eorum qui traditioni & consensui innituntur. & quid tandem traditio & consensus? مالنا عليه اليوم واصحابي illud (inquit) quod ego & socii mei jam profitemur. Sectam istam Author modò laudatus, ut diximus, Ale-Asshariam esse contendit, cui ergo nomen illud κατ' ἐξοχὴν tribuit, quod idem unumquemque de ea, cui ipse nomen dederit, sectà pronunciaturum minimè dubium est. Cùm autem praedixerit Mohammedes tot futuras, necesse est ut 73 sectas inter suos reperiant. At quorsum 73? nempe, ut ita religioni Christianae praeponderet Mohammedanismus sectarum numero, ut illa jam ante Judaismo, Judaismus Magorum professi-oni, ita scil. tradunt, افترقت المجوس علي سبعين فرقة واليهود علي احدي وسبعين والنصاري علي اثنتي وسبعين والمسلمون علي ثلث وسبعين والنا جية ابدا من الفرق واحدة Divisi sunt Magi in 70 Sectas, Judaei in 71. Christiani in 72. Moslemi in 73. Inter Sectas autem una semper fuit, quae Salvanda.

Quod ad Motazalas (seu Motazalos) attinet, &c.] Sectae hujus Author & Princeps perhibetur واصل بن عطا Wasel Ebn Ata, Alhasani Basrensis discipulus, cui & affectis ipsius nomen hoc, quod Separatos denotat, ideò impositum (referente AlSharesta-nio)

page.notes: Arabic and Greek passages are copied from the scan with doubtful letters unmarked; the Arabic in the first two lines is hard to read and may contain errors. "quarum una" appears as "quarum ma" with a possibly blurred letter. "esset" may read "effet". "Mof-lemi" is printed as such at the line end, and "Mof" is likely a printing error for "Mos". Two marginal notes at the right: "Shareft." beside the Judaism line, and "l. 12." beside "Quod ad Motazalas". The "[" and "]" brackets around "Quod ad Motazalas" are printed as shown. Heavy scan staining and show-through in the lower right and left margin.
